species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 53°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 6–38 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 70 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 100 ft, so fish stay above it.
Southeast wind at 21 mph pushes bait onto the northwest shore: try the wind-blown banks.
